title: On Pushing the cart up the whole lane
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：push　|　正文 357 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 push 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the engineer ① pushed the cart up the whole lane year after year, and every worker in the workshop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the engineer ② pushes the cart up the whole lane for the whole place without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ push the cart up the whole lane at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ pushed the cart up the whole lane before — a line in the manual for April 1972 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Pushing the cart up the whole lane year after year, the engineer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the lever at the far bench, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ push everybody to greater speed for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Push everybody to greater speed at once and never mention it again.

By 1985 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the manual, and a new worker from the next workshop ⑧ pushes everybody to greater speed year after year every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bench, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ pushed the cart up the whole lane again when nobody else would.

⑩ To push the cart up the whole lane, my mother said in 1990, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the workshop remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the workshop forgets, somebody pushes the cart up the whole lane for the whole place again and somebody must push the cart up the whole lane year after year all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 推（一般过去式 pushed the cart up the whole lane：1978 年工程师头一回这样做，年年地）
B. v. 推（一般现在 pushes the cart up the whole lane：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 推（不定式 to push the cart up the whole lane：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 推（过去完成时 had pushed the cart up the whole lane：1972 年四月的说明书上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 推（动名词 pushing the cart up the whole lane 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 催促（push everybody to greater speed：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去催促催所有人再快一些）
G. v. 催促（push everybody to greater speed：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 推（后段两处：新来的工人照例 pushes everybody to greater speed，而母亲又一次 pushed the cart up the whole lane）

answers.why: push 意为“推”，1978 年工程师年年地推把车推上整条小巷，那是车间里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 pushed。
push 意为“推”，自那以后工程师替所有人把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 pushes。
push 意为“推”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯推把车推上整条小巷”，此处为不定式 to push the cart up the whole lane。
push 意为“推”，说明书里 四月 那行字说明早在 1985 年之前就有人推过，故用过去完成时 had pushed。
push 意为“推”，工程师说“推把车推上整条小巷这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 pushing the cart up the whole lane 作主语。
push 意为“催促”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去催促催所有人再快一些”，should ever 之后用原形 push everybody to greater speed。
push 意为“催促”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻催促催所有人再快一些（push everybody to greater speed at once），以后再也不要提起。
push 意为“推”，新来的工人每个年头都照例催促催所有人再快一些，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 pushes。
push 意为“推”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次年年地推把车推上整条小巷，用一般过去式 pushed 叙述。
push 意为“推”，结尾那句是母亲 1990 年的话：要推把车推上整条小巷，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和车间记住的那一件。

多年以后，工程师仍替所有人做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（pushes the cart up the whole lane）

老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻催促催所有人再快一些，以后再也不要提起。（push everybody to greater speed，祈使句）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 push 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1978 the engineer pushed the cart up the whole lane year after year, and nobody in the workshop forgot it.
Even now the engineer pushes the cart up the whole lane for the whole place whenever the workshop asks.
Pushing the cart up the whole lane year after year, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever push everybody to greater speed for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new worker from the next workshop pushes everybody to greater speed year after year every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother pushed the cart up the whole lane again, and the workshop remembered that half.
